description: City of Winnipeg Electricity and Natural Gas Utility Data is a dataset listed in City of Winnipeg open data portal (data.winnipeg.ca), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Winnipeg. This dataset contains utility billing data for the City of Winnipeg’s s facilities, sourced from Manitoba Hydro. It includes information on electricity and natural gas consumption, demand and costs, across municipal buildings and operations. Coverage: Winnipeg. The table has 35 columns. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Canada Open Government Licence. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support gas network and biomethane studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-data-winnipeg-ca-portal.
